meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建带时间轴的可渲染动画或视频项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把分镜或脚本规整成带片段和轨道的可渲染媒体项目
copy.tagline_en: Build a renderable animated or video project with structured clips and tracks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your storyboard or script into a renderable media project with tracks and clips

howto.what: 安装后，当 Claude 写或改 HyperFrames 的 HTML 视频项目时，会按既定契约做：时间用 data-* 属性标记、每个项目只登记一条暂停时间轴、媒体播放交给框架，并在交付前做命令行验证。
howto.when: 当你要创建或修改 HyperFrames 的 HTML 视频项目、编写计划文档（STORYBOARD/SCRIPT），或调试其中时间/媒体/渲染规则时，该技能会生效。

say.text: 给该项目加一个子组合：2 秒处出现、持续 3 秒，内含一张图片的动画。
say.note: 它会接好宿主属性、模板和每实例变量。

howto.what_en: With this skill loaded, Claude follows the HyperFrames contract when writing or editing HTML compositions: declares timing with data-* attributes, one paused timeline per project, framework-owned media, no forbidden animation patterns, then runs CLI validation.
howto.when_en: Use it when creating or editing a HyperFrames HTML composition, writing STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plan files, or debugging its timing/media/render rules.

say_en.text: Add a sub-composition that starts at second 2 and lasts 3 seconds, containing an animated image.
say_en.note: It wires host attributes, template, and per-instance variables.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check on this project and explain/fix any lint errors.
say_en.note: It runs lint, runtime, and layout checks and reports results.
